pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: AP e-governance schemes (Rajiv Internet Village)

patterns: Census-town criteria asked as 'which is NOT correct' with 60% vs 75% male non-farm workers as the trap.
APPSC tilt is AP Census data: largest rural population district (East Godavari), districts below a national urbanisation benchmark (Srikakulam, Vizianagaram, West Godavari).
Other PSCs use 'NOT an element/feature' items (cultural diversity not rural; informal ties not urban) and scholar-village matches (Rampura-Srinivas, Shamirpet-Dube).
App MCQs add Economic Survey 2025-26 views and scholar concepts beyond PYQ depth; core census and AP-data items match the exam well.
